The Friday Five!!!

Here are some things I’ve been loving this week:

1. This laundry detergent by @lavantcollective in linen smells like hotel sheets. Not too fragranced just perfect! One of the very few scented detergents I can tolerate

2. Obsessed with these plantain chips by @enjoysolula who knew! Trying to switch things up with the old tortilla chip standby and these are DELICIOUS

3. This cleansing balm by @elemis smells HEAVENLY and I am sad to wash it off every time, but it leaves my skin feeling sososo soft. Then follow up with a cleanser because pollution in the city is a thing.

4. How beautiful is this picture frame by @cimelioblu 💙 now must find a photo for it! I love love love the shell detailing 🐚🐚🐚

5. My cat Sweetie. Sweetie is so stylish and elegant and is the cutest cat in the land. 10/10 highly recommend CATS

These things are on my ShopMy and in my Amazon storefront except for Sweetie and the frame 💛💛
